The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: What data says about Tukaram Mundhe’s 100-day stint as FDA Commissioner
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: When compared with the data in the year 2025-26, the last three months have seen a 557% increase in the number of complaints received, 378% increase in investigation of complaints, and a 217% increase in the number of searches and seizures.

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: Maharashtra will shut down within 10 minutes if Maratha protesters are harmed: Manoj Jarange Patil
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: Manoj Jarange Patil appealed to female members of the community to treat all the sons and daughters of the Maratha community as their own and act accordingly, while asking the entire community not to act aggressively towards police and protest silently.
